jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Software Engineer 2

Remote - Poland Optional office base in Lublin

We’re looking for a Software Engineer 2 to join our growing engineering team in Poland and help build secure, high-quality software for the Pharmaceutical Trial Master File (TMF) industry.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a developer who is ready to take the next step - someone who can work independently, contribute to solution design, and help shape how modern software is built in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

You’ll be part of a new team creating software for a specialist pharmaceutical domain, with the chance to use modern AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of everyday delivery.

What You’ll Be Doing

Fixing moderately complex bugs in familiar code and tackling basic issues in unfamiliar code.
Building new functionality independently with architectural guidance where needed.
Developing with .NET and C#, applying SOLID principles, design patterns and dependency injection.
Writing reliable unit tests and contributing to strong engineering quality standards.
Using AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while critically reviewing code for quality, security and correctness.
Collaborating with testers and DevOps, contributing to sprint planning, and helping solve support issues at the root cause.
Mentoring more junior developers and supporting high coding standards across the team.
Building your knowledge of the Pharmaceutical TMF domain and applying it in real solutions for clients.

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of software development experience.
Strong experience with Microsoft .NET / C#.
Experience with unit testing, dependency injection, and REST web services.
Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, Azure SQL or MySQL.
Exposure to web UI development such as React, Angular or jQuery.
Confidence using AI-assisted coding tools with a critical eye on output quality and security.
Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach.

Why join us

Remote role based in Poland.
Lublin office available if you’d like to work from there - but it’s not a requirement.
A chance to join a new engineering team and make a visible impact as it grows.
Opportunity to work in a specialist pharmaceutical technology space with plenty of room to learn and grow.
Preferred knowledge of GCP and/or TMF is helpful, but not essential.

If you’re a software engineer who enjoys solving problems, writing quality code and working with modern tools in a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

What Cencora offers

Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.

Full time

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend/C#)
Senior Software Engineer (Backend/C#)
Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Platform)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Why A365 Software Engineering?

Build The Cloud Platform That’s Transforming Electronics Design. Altium 365 For Cloud Lets Design Engineers Communicate, Collaborate And Bring Their Ideas To Market More Efficiently Than Any Platform In The Industry. These Are Some Of The R&D Software Engineering Contributions You Might Make To Altium 365

Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
Large-scale data processing; data modelling; holistic, intent-based API design
Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.

A day in the Life of our
Senior Software Engineer

Your primary role will be product development for complex cloud applications with the Altium 365 Platform team.

Technologies We Use

.NET Core, .NET Framework 4.8., MySQL
AWS cloud
Microservices
GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes.

There are 100+ services in the product.

Qualifications

What We're looking for

7+ years of .NET experience
Deep expertise in one or more of these areas: identity and authentication, access or license management, message queues/brokers, distributed caches, ElasticSearch/OpenSearch, relational database design and optimization, platform framework development, multi-tenancy, Rings Protection Model in cloud development
Proven experience building and operating distributed, high-load systems, including performance profiling, optimisation, load testing, and stress testing
Strong ability to solve complex technical challenges that differ from typical market products, combining engineering software and cloud services
Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and drive architectural decisions
Experience defining and driving engineering standards, best practices, and technical governance at a platform level

Nice to have

Firebird, Oracle, Postgres.
Azure/GCP/AliCloud

Additional Information

Altium’s Website ( http://altium.com )
Altium Customer Stories ( https://www.youtube.com/@AltiumStories )

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
